verdict.rationale: Undermind produces a written synthesis over a ranked set of papers, answers questions across many papers at once, and lets users trace each statement to its source through in-line citations. That means answers are tied to multiple sources rather than given as a single unqualified claim. However, nothing in the evidence says it explicitly shows where sources agree or disagree. Missing for 10: explicit agreement/contradiction or consensus mapping across papers, documentation of how conflicting findings are presented, and independent or hands-on corroboration of disagreement surfacing.
